# T-2: Complete provider migration

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Make `senti upgrade` complete missing provider plugins for non-base types and migrate legacy project-local preset content.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Upgrade can add official default source when needed for non-base type completion.
- Upgrade installs/enables providers for the full non-base parent chain.
- Legacy `.senti/presets/<key>` content is migrated to local plugin source/package or fails with a clear error.

## Implementation Notes
Focus on `src/upgrade.js` and `src/lib/plugin-registry.js`. Preserve command names and user-facing option meanings. Official default source is id `official-presets`, type `git`, remote `git@github.com:SpreadWorks/senti-presets.git`; tests may use a local fixture source with equivalent manifest. For manifestless `.senti/presets/<key>`, copy parent/scan/chapters from a matching provider or migrate as bare preset when no provider exists. Validate `--dry-run`/`--help` as booleans and config source fields at entry. Bound source count to 100 and parent depth to 16.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local CLI tests for R3/R4/R9 success and failure paths, including exit codes.
